name: event_retention_view
describes: A Run whose timeline was pruned at cursor 120 and still holds everything after it. `events_are_authority` is false by construction and `authoritative_sources` names the records that answer what the Run did, so 'the events were cleaned up' and 'the record of the action is gone' cannot be read as the same statement.

source.note: EventRetentionView; the prune itself is runs/events.py:prune_events, which deletes only from `audit_events`.
